# githubsettings_repository_pull_requests (Resource)

Manages whether pull requests are enabled in one repository and who can create them. Creating or updating this resource applies the configured settings to GitHub; destroying it removes the resource from Terraform state without changing them. Requires a token with repository administration write access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_repository_pull_requests" "example" {
  owner                        = "example-owner"
  repository                   = "example-repository"
  has_pull_requests            = true
  pull_request_creation_policy = "all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `has_pull_requests` (Boolean) Enable pull requests.
- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `pull_request_creation_policy` (String) Who can create pull requests. Allowed values are all, collaborators_only.
- `repository` (String) GitHub repository name within the owner account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import githubsettings_repository_pull_requests.example example-owner/example-repository
```
